description: This file defines the SkillSearchFilterParams class used for filtering and managing search parameters for skills within the OrangeHRM application. It extends a base FilterParams class and includes properties for 'name' and 'description', along with getter and setter methods. It also specifies allowed sorting fields and sets a default sort field in the constructor.

classes.name: SkillSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object class used to specify search filter parameters for skill entities in the OrangeHRM system. It supports filtering by name and description, and manages sorting preferences.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of the SkillSearchFilterParams class and sets the default sort field to 's.name'.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the current value of the 'name' filter parameter.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the value of the 'name' filter parameter.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the current value of the 'description' filter parameter.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the value of the 'description' filter parameter.
